To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hashtags and the memes are the two most important elements for the communication in the social web.

(i) the hashtags and memes used in the social networks are not always related to the events they are supposed to represent, (ii) the memes and hashtags are more used by women and the younger age group, (iii) the memes and the hashtags are more used in the evening, and (iv) the memes and hashtag are more used in a more informal language.

1) the use of hashtags on Twitter during the Olympic games is a way to express emotions and to show the social identity of people; 2) the use of memes on Facebook is a way to share emotions and to show a sense of belonging to a group.

the study of the use of hashtags, memes and other resources for communication in social networks.
the study of social networks and their impact in the society.
the analysis of social networks and the use of social media, especially the use of hashtags, memes, and the impact of the social web in the dissemination of information.

the use of hashtags in SNOs is an effective way to disseminate content.

hashtags and memes are a very important and effective way of communication, and that their use is a trend that is growing and is here to stay.
